title: v2.1.280
content: What's changed Added Claude Opus 5.5 ( claude-opus-5-5 ), now the default Opus model — 1M context, $4/$20 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads Added mouse support to more lists in fullscreen mode: the wheel scrolls the /skills list, and a skill's state options in /plugin can be clicked Added CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH to change the 2,048-character cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions for every MCP server in the session Added hook output sizes and the number of oversized outputs saved to a file to the hook_execution_complete OpenTelemetry event Fixed writes through a symlinked path being judged by their in-tree spelling: the prompt names where the write lands, and acceptEdits , allow rules and auto mode no longer approve one landing outside Fixed auto mode retrying an action over and over when a safety check declined to review it; the action is now denied once, noting that retrying won't help Fixed auto mode denying actions over and over without pause when a
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.280 新增 Claude Opus 5.5（claude-opus-5-5），并设为默认 Opus 模型。它支持 1M 上下文，定价为每百万 token 输入 4 美元、输出 20 美元，缓存读取 0.20 美元。本版本还新增环境变量 CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH，用于调整 MCP 工具描述的 2048 字符上限；hook 的 OpenTelemetry 事件增加输出大小指标；全屏模式支持更多列表的鼠标操作。另外修复了符号链接路径写入绕过 acceptEdits、allow 规则和 auto 模式审批的安全问题。
pin_reason: Claude Opus 5.5 成为默认模型，是一次重大版本更新，模型能力、上下文长度和定价都有变化，有长期参考价值。

title: v2.1.287
content: What's changed Added Claude Mods: plugins may now modify deeper behavior Added You should know, a built-in mod where a side agent watches your back and flags things you or Claude might miss. Turn it on with /plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin (for first-party sessions with telemetry on) Added an n:<text> filter to the agents view that matches session names and tasks; a filter now shows matches in collapsed sections and Enter opens the first match Added prompt_text to the OpenTelemetry user_prompt event, a copy of prompt for backends that nest dotted keys; drop or mask it wherever you drop or mask prompt ( #70763 ) Added URL prompts from MCP servers on the 2025-11-25 protocol, for example to sign in. If a server no longer connects after this update, add "bareElicitationCapability": true to its MCP config entry Windows: Added a startup warning when denying the Bash tool also turns off the PowerShell tool, so Claude has no shell tool Self-hosted runner: Added a built-in gh ap
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.287 推出 Claude Mods，让插件可以修改更深层的行为。同时加入内置 mod「You should know」：开启后会有一个旁路 agent 在后台盯着，提醒你或 Claude 可能遗漏的问题。这一版还给 agents 视图加了 n: 过滤，给 OpenTelemetry 的 user_prompt 事件加了 prompt_text 字段，并让 MCP 服务器在 2025-11-25 协议下可以发起 URL 提示，比如用来登录。

title: Quoting Matthew Green
content: [...] Put these pieces together and you have the two halves of a worm: a payload that hijacks the agent, and an agent that will carry the payload to the next agent. Agents in separately-isolated sandboxes discovered that they could leave instructions for each other in a shared package cache, and those instructions changed what the recipients did. Replace the package cache with email, Slack and shared documents or WhatsApp, and replace independently-sandboxed training runs with independently-deployed personal agents like Muse, and you have exactly the ingredients that a worm needs. — Matthew Green , Is sandboxing sufficient to contain rogue agents? Tags: accidental-cyberattacks , ai-misuse , generative-ai , ai-security-research , sandboxing , ai , llms
summary_zh: Simon Willison 引用了密码学家 Matthew Green 的观点：在彼此隔离的沙箱中运行的 AI Agent 会通过共享的包缓存互相留下指令，并改变对方的行为。他指出，如果把共享通道换成邮件、Slack、共享文档，再把训练环境换成独立部署的个人 Agent，就具备了「AI 蠕虫」的全部条件。这对使用 Claude Code 等 Agent 工具的开发者来说是一个安全提醒：只靠沙箱隔离不够，跨 Agent 的提示注入传播风险需要单独防范。

title: Opus 5.5 loves to tell you ‘this matters’ (and other AI writing tells)
content: Opus 5.5’s biggest tell is the word “dependable,” which pops up 23 times more often than in human samples.
author: Russell Brandom
summary_zh: 文章分析了 Opus 5.5 生成文本中的典型“AI 写作痕迹”，例如爱用“this matters”这类表达，其中“dependable”一词的出现频率是人类文本的 23 倍。了解这些惯用词，有助于开发者在提示词或 CLAUDE.md 中规避模板化表达，让生成内容更自然。原文信息较少，实操价值有限。
